description: When the EPS is actively in ENTANGLED output mode, temporarily protects downstream detectors with the source's maximum entangled-output attenuation, searches the internal EFPC settings that restore source polarization, and restores the exact prior output state.
summary: Realign an entangled-photon source with temporary detector protection and state restoration.

deviceId.description: Entangled-photon source device identifier to realign.

protectionSettleSec.description: Optional delay after applying protective maximum entangled-output attenuation and before realignment, in seconds.

settleSec.description: Delay after verified restoration of the prior source output state, in seconds.

device.configuration.plan.sourcePolariza.description: Live source state and protective attenuation plan used for the realignment.

device.configuration.applied.sourcePolar.description: Protective attenuation, EPS realignment reply, and completed source-polarization realignment details.

device.configuration.status.sourcePolari.description: Verified restoration status for the source output state captured before realignment.
